h1: Best Gym for Students in NZ 2026
intro: Student budgets are tight and timetables change every semester, so the best student gym in NZ is cheap, flexible, and ideally near campus. Here's how the major chains compare on student pricing, lock-in terms, and 24/7 access for 2026.

sections.heading: Cheapest Student Gym Memberships in NZ (2026)
sections.body: For most students, the cheapest flexible option is a budget chain with no long lock-in. City Fitness starts from $7.99/week with a 4-week minimum term, and Jetts offers 24/7 access from $14.95/week with no lock-in — handy when you leave town over summer.

sections.heading: Gyms with Genuine Student Discounts
sections.body: Les Mills offers under-23s around 20% off standard membership, which can make a premium club competitive with budget chains. Always ask at signup and bring a current student ID — discounts are rarely advertised online.

sections.heading: University & Campus Gyms vs Commercial Chains
sections.body: Most NZ universities (Otago, Massey, Auckland, Victoria, Canterbury) run subsidised campus recreation centres that are often the cheapest option if you live near campus. Commercial chains win on 24/7 access, more locations, and group fitness variety.

sections.heading: Best No-Contract Options for Students
sections.body: If your living situation changes each semester, prioritise no lock-in: Jetts, Contours, and ClassPass let you start and stop without paying out a contract. City Fitness's 4-week minimum is also student-friendly.

sections.heading: How to Get the Cheapest Student Gym Deal
list: Always ask about student or under-23 rates — they're often unadvertised
Sign up online to get joining fees waived at City Fitness, Jetts and Snap Fitness
Check your university recreation centre first if you live near campus
Avoid 12-month contracts if you leave town over summer — pick no lock-in
Use ClassPass's free first month to trial studios before committing
